aberrant-heir.summary: Bears an aberrant dragonmark that has brought suspicion or hostility from the houses, whether hidden, flaunted or tied to House Tarkanan's outlaws.

archaeologist.summary: A scholar of vanished civilizations who splits time between libraries and remote ruins, part historian and part treasure hunter.

house-agent.summary: Works for a dragonmarked house, by blood or by contract, without a mark of their own, carrying out the house's business far and wide.

house-cannith-heir.summary: A scion of the house of makers, expected to invent, study or deal on its behalf while its feuding barons fight over who leads it.

house-deneith-heir.summary: Raised in the house of guards and mercenaries to value duty, honor and law, perhaps as a bodyguard, sellsword or bounty marshal.

house-ghallanda-heir.summary: Grew up among the comforts of the hospitality house's inns, as a warm host or a schemer who trades on others' trust.

house-jorasco-heir.summary: Trained by the healers' house to fight sickness and injury, for a fair fee, whether as a gentle physician or a precise killer.

house-kundarak-heir.summary: A proud member of the dwarven house of vaults and wards, upholding, bending or defying its code of honor and order.

house-lyrandar-heir.summary: Born into the house of wind and wave, now riding high on airships, with a past at sea, among weather-workers or on an airship crew.

house-medani-heir.summary: Raised in the house of warning to spot plots and threats before they unfold, protecting clients through foresight rather than force.

house-orien-heir.summary: Of the house of couriers and the lightning rail, working to keep trade moving and to reopen routes the war cut off.

house-phiarlan-heir.summary: An heir of the house of entertainers who prizes secrets above wealth, performing in public or serving its hidden spy network.

house-sivis-heir.summary: From the ancient house of scribes and messengers, which shapes events quietly through communication and mediation.

house-tharashk-heir.summary: Raised in a young, scrappy house of finders that taught self-reliance and the hunter's approach to every challenge.

house-thuranni-heir.summary: Of a young house split from the shadow-marked elves, expected to gather and pass on information for the family at every turn.

house-vadalis-heir.summary: Brought up close to family and the natural world, wise to life's cycles and to the deceits of city dwellers.

inquisitive.summary: A curious investigator who solves crimes, finds the missing and exposes conspiracies, freelance, for an agency, a broadsheet or the watch.
